column1: # Rule: an element with an id attribute is a variable named by the id value
# (no quotes), on the line its start tag begins. Not definitions: tag names
# (custom elements included), class / name / data-* / for attributes, anchor
# links, an empty id, an id containing white space, an id that is template
# syntax ({{ }}, <% %>, ${ }, @), and anything inside <script>, <style> or a
# comment. Narrow because an id is unique per document and is the only name
# markup gives an element; every other attribute repeats across elements.
